summary.one_liner: Docker Compose tooling for running a self-hosted Jitsi Meet video conferencing stack, with images published on GitHub Container Registry.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides the files needed to run the Jitsi Meet stack on Docker using Docker Compose. Jitsi Meet is described as a fully encrypted, open source video conferencing solution that needs no account. All project images are published to GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) under tags including stable, versioned stable releases, unstable, and daily unstable builds dated by day. The README points to a separate installation manual for setup details, which is not included in the README text itself. It also mentions a related project, Jitsi on Kubernetes, for deploying the stack on a Kubernetes cluster.
use_cases: deploy Jitsi Meet with Docker Compose
team video meetings on own infrastructure
how_to_run: Read the installation manual referenced in the README
Pull images from GitHub Container Registry using the stable tag (e.g. ghcr.io images tagged stable)
Configure the environment and start the stack with Docker Compose
notable: Official Jitsi Meet Docker Compose setup maintained by the Jitsi project
Images published to GitHub Container Registry with stable and unstable tag channels
Daily unstable builds tagged by date
Companion Kubernetes tooling in the separate Jitsi on Kubernetes project
caveats: Setup details are in an external installation manual not contained in the README
Kubernetes deployment is handled by a separate project
README does not state system requirements or licensing details
keywords: run video conference on my server
